newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Alpargatas boosted by report.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Alpargatas boosted by report.

text.p: Stocks of Argentine footwear and textile maker Alpargatas rose Wednesday on news of company streamlining plans, defying a slump on the bolsa, dealers said.
"News the company will sell non-core assets and focus on its central business makes the stock look attractive at these prices," one broker said.

In an interview Wednesday in La Nacion newspaper, the company's vice-president said Alpargatas would sell some plants and real estate and was considering a long-term bond placement to finance its restructuring process.
The 24-share blue-chip MerVal index was quoted 0.8 percent lower at 738.84 less than an hour before the close, showing only four rising issues.
Alpargatas led those main-tier gains, jumping 1.1 percent to $0.94 per share.
